description: Single source of truth for infrastructure-prefix error codes (GATEWAY_* / INTERNAL_*). Business-domain prefixes such as ANALYSIS_* / CONVERSATION_* / SEMANTIC_* live in each service's OpenAPI details.errorCode enum and are NOT duplicated here.

GATEWAY_IDENTITY_MISSING.trigger: Protected route received a missing or malformed X-Auth-User-Id — Oathkeeper mutator was not applied or the request bypassed the gateway entirely.

GATEWAY_SUBJECT_UNVERIFIED.trigger: Protected route received no Authorization: Bearer token, or the token failed JWKS signature / iss / aud / exp verification. Issued by the backend's Oathkeeper id_token mutator verifier (architecture-tasks §Task 8) — flips the historic X-Auth-* plaintext trust model to an integrity-protected one.

GATEWAY_SUBJECT_MISMATCH.trigger: Verified JWT claims do not agree with the X-Auth-* header triple (e.g. sub != X-Auth-User-Id). Indicates the X-Auth-* headers were injected by a party other than Oathkeeper while the JWT itself was genuine — same silent-bypass vector §Task 8 closes.

GATEWAY_CSRF_INVALID.trigger: Unsafe HTTP method missing X-Xsrf-Token header, or header value did not match the XSRF-TOKEN cookie (double-submit failure).
GATEWAY_CSRF_INVALID.retryGuidance: Ensure the browser has a fresh XSRF-TOKEN cookie, mirror it in X-XSRF-TOKEN, and retry exactly once.

GATEWAY_NOT_READY.trigger: GET /gateway/ready aggregated at least one upstream whose /internal/ready probe returned non-200 or timed out.

INTERNAL_AUTH_FAILED.trigger: /api/internal/* path received a request whose X-Internal-Auth header was missing or did not match the shared secret. Deliberately 500 (not 401/403) because any occurrence signals gateway routing drift, not a user-facing auth failure.
